provider.modelsRequestFailed: Could not fetch the model list.
knowledge.missing: Library reference is unavailable: the knowledge corpus is not built.
panel.title: Assistant
turn.noProvider: No model channel is configured: pick a provider and connect it.
turn.noForm: Open a form — the assistant edits the schema of the active tab.
turn.noStack: No plugin edits forms — enable a form stack.
turn.error: The turn ended with an error.
turn.notApplied.invalid: Changes not applied — they would make the form invalid: {errors}
turn.notApplied.closed: Changes not applied: the form is closed.
turn.notApplied.failed: Changes were not written to the working copy: {error}
turn.restoreFailed: The form could not be restored: {error}
turn.undo.nothing: Nothing to undo: the assistant has not changed the form yet.
turn.undo.closed: The form the assistant edited is closed — open it to undo the turn.
turn.undo.overlapped: The assistant turn is already overlaid by a hand edit: undoing it whole would lose that edit. To bring the form back to its state before the turn, use Restore on your own message.
turn.files.broken: The form files do not assemble, so the assistant cannot check its edits against them: {error}
turn.undo.created: The turn is undone, but the files it created remain — delete them by hand if you do not need them: {files}
turn.silent.fix: Usually this means the answer went into reasoning and was cut off: a local model needs a larger context window (num_ctx / OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH), and the task is worth splitting into smaller parts.
turn.silent.tools: The assistant called tools but changed nothing and said nothing. {fix}
turn.silent.none: The assistant did nothing and said nothing. {fix}
chat.placeholder: What should I do with the form?
chat.restore.hint: Restore the form to its state before “{text}”
chat.empty.title: The assistant edits the open form
chat.empty.hint: Describe what to do: “add an email field”, “make the phone required”, “put first and last name on one line”.
changes.conflict: The form was edited while the assistant was working. Applying will overwrite those edits.
settings.rememberKey: Remember the key in this browser
settings.rememberKey.hint: Unchecked, the key lives only until the page reloads and never reaches disk.
settings.emptyModels: The provider returned an empty model list.
settings.mode: How the assistant edits the form
settings.mode.hint: In files mode the model edits the form module's files itself — the schema, validation and behaviour code; every edit lands at once, and an edit that breaks the form is rejected. Changing the mode starts a new conversation.
settings.limits.hint: Empty fields mean no limit. On a paid channel the input-token cap is the one that protects you: the price of a step grows with the dialogue. Setting any limit too low cuts the turn off mid-form.
settings.origin.browser: Requests go from the browser straight to the provider. The key is stored in this browser and is reachable by the page — use a key with a limited budget.
settings.origin.loopback: Requests go to a local server and never leave the machine.
chat.attach.unknownScheme: The assistant has no way to read {uri}
chat.attach.howTo: Attach a file from the project tree with “Attach to assistant”, or with the paperclip in the chat.
turn.failedEdits: No edit was applied — the form is unchanged, whatever the assistant says: {error}
turn.create.lost: The new form {path} could not be opened — open it and ask again.
turn.generate.done: Form code generated in {dir}: {count} files written. They are not saved yet — check them, then choose File → Save all.
turn.generate.kept: Left untouched as edited by hand: {files}.
turn.generate.pending: the turn's edits await your decision — generate the code once they apply
turn.generate.unavailable: code generation is off in this build
turn.pending.dropped: The unapplied changes of this turn were discarded by a new request.
turn.undo.otherForm: The turn was undone in {path}, which is not on screen now.
turn.rules.broken: The turn's rules were not saved: the rules file {path} does not parse ({error}). The form layout was changed — fix the file and ask again.
settings.busy: The assistant is still working — connect once the turn ends.
chat.target.none: No form is open — open one for the assistant to edit.
chat.question.cancelled: Questions withdrawn: the turn was stopped without an answer.
chat.question.waiting: The assistant is waiting for answers to the questions above
